text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gold City hasn't been in the best shape 
lately, so we came to visit a shrine."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A shrine for a breather? What kind of 
choice is that? ...is what I thought at 
first, but it's actually pretty nice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's quiet, and best of all, there's no 
one around to see us.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Coming to a shrine like this is totally 
different from visiting one for a modeling 
gig, which makes it fun.
choice_data_list: A modeling job at a shrine?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I get a prayer blessing done before 
big collections, or before shooting a new 
show.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A pretty big group lined up in a row, and 
they had that white paper-shaker thing 
waved over them—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I didn't hate the atmosphere back 
then, either. It wasn't child's play, so 
everyone had that hungry, sharp look in 
their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Whether you're fired up or feeling down, 
once you've done everything you can, all 
that's left is to pray to the gods."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, shall we go pay our respects at the 
shrine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang, clang—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Umm, God? I've been feeling weirdly off 
my game lately, so I'd really like to fix 
that.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I won't ask you to 'make me fast' or 
anything. Just... let my successes and 
failures be by my own strength.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well, it might just be for peace 
of mind, but doing this is kind of like 
getting proper closure—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think I'm starting to feel a bit 
better!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Was I panicking too much, thinking I 
didn't have enough time?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go, Trainer. With this, I 
think I'll be able to focus on training 
from tomorrow on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight illuminated her back as she 
strode briskly ahead. The sight was 
reminiscent of seeing her on the runway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, an email from my manager.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Urgent work? You're coming to pick me 
up right now?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta be kidding, and here I 
thought I finally had a day off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
God, are you seriously shoving more work 
onto me on top of this? I never asked for 
any of this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City's prayers went unanswered, and 
she couldn't seem to shake her slump...
